customers_say: Customers find the water purifier to be of good quality, easy to use with smooth operation, and appreciate its taste, with one noting it matches normal ground water. The installation process receives positive feedback, and customers like the water quality, particularly noting the purity and TDS levels. The reliability and value for money receive mixed reviews - while some report no issues, others mention the purifier stopping working completely, and opinions on value are divided between those who find it good value and those who consider it not worth the investment. Service experiences are also mixed, with some praising the service while others report poor service.

reviews.author: Anu
reviews.title: Defective Unit! Broke down 5 times in 6 months. Terrible Service.
reviews.body: Do not buy this product. I purchased the Kent Supreme less than a year ago, and it has already failed 5times in the first 6 months. Major components like the SMPS and Carbon Filter have already been replaced. ​Now, the machine is dispensing foul, bad-smelling water. The service team is completely uncoordinated—one day support tells me to pay ₹500 for a Post-Carbon filter, and the next day a technician visits and says the UV membrane is broken which is cost min 1100.
